addons.name: Dogs BaseHunting & Misc Tools
addons.author: doghero002-cmd
addons.summary: Seed cracking, stash & tunnel finders, DonutSMP tools
addons.description: Base hunting for DIH: seed cracking, coordinate finders, stash, tunnel and chunk finders, DonutSMP tools. Network features are opt-in: SeedCrackerX database (off), DonutSMP API, OpenAI or your own AI endpoint, Google Translate, Discord webhooks. Needs DIH 5.1 beta.

addons.name: Leaf Dupe
addons.author: numberz
addons.summary: Universal small-dripleaf dupe for Spigot and older Paper
addons.description: Bone meals an upper-half small dripleaf and re-breaks a block every cycle to duplicate it. Works on Spigot, and on Paper and forks up to 26.1.2 (Paper fixed it in 26.2); not vanilla. Normal and Grim modes, Detect sets it up. Port of numberz's AUTISM Client addon.
